title: Biden order directs Treasury to restrict US investment in Chinese chips, quantum and AI
summary: The executive order declares a national emergency over investments that could advance sensitive technologies in China, Hong Kong and Macau and requires notification or prohibition of some transactions.

title: California regulator votes 3-1 to let Cruise and Waymo offer robotaxi rides at all hours in San Francisco
summary: The California Public Utilities Commission approved the expanded service.

title: China's first generative AI measures take effect, covering providers that serve the Chinese public, including foreign ones
summary: The measures apply to providers offering generative AI services to the public in China.

title: The New York Times, CNN, Reuters and other publishers block OpenAI's GPTBot crawler
summary: Wikipedia reports that the Times also updated its terms to bar use of its content in large language models.

title: A study in the journal Public Choice reports a systematic political lean in ChatGPT's answers
summary: Wikipedia says the study found a bias toward Democrats in the US, Lula in Brazil and the Labour Party in the UK.

title: California DMV asks Cruise to cut its active driverless fleet by half while it investigates recent incidents
summary: The request came after a Cruise vehicle struck a pedestrian and other incidents.

title: US court rules that AI-generated art cannot receive copyright protection
summary: A US court denied copyright protection to an AI-generated work, according to Analytics Vidhya.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: San Francisco Fire Department reports a firetruck responding with sirens collided with a Cruise robotaxi
summary: Cruise said a passenger in the vehicle was injured.

title: Spain's government approves the statute of AESIA, its AI supervision agency
summary: The statute was approved on 22 August 2023, setting up what the page calls the first EU country body dedicated to supervising AI.
srcName: Wikipedia (es): Agencia Española de Supervisión de la Inteligencia Artificial

title: Nvidia reports quarterly revenue of USD 13.51bn, up 101% on the year, and guides next quarter to USD 16bn
summary: Data-centre revenue reached USD 10.32bn in the quarter ended 30 July 2023.

title: Huawei releases Mate 60 Pro with a 7 nm Kirin 9000S chip that Wikipedia says SMIC produced
summary: The launch was moved up and coincided with a US Commerce Secretary visit to China.

title: Baidu opens Ernie Bot to the public after receiving Chinese regulatory approval
summary: Ernie Bot became available to the public on 31 August 2023.

title: Arabic Post, citing the Financial Times, reports Saudi Arabia and the UAE are each buying thousands of Nvidia AI chips
summary: The report says Saudi Arabia, through KAUST, and the UAE are acquiring thousands of high-end Nvidia processors to build national AI capacity.

title: Naver unveils HyperCLOVA X, its Korean-focused large language model, at its DAN 23 conference
summary: Naver presented HyperCLOVA X with the CLOVA X chatbot and Cue search service, saying it is trained on more Korean data than other large models.

title: G42's Inception, MBZUAI and Cerebras launch Jais, an Arabic-English large language model released with open weights
summary: Jais, a 13bn-parameter bilingual model, was released for open use and described by its developers as the highest-quality Arabic language model.
